name: vios-engage
description: The engagement wrapper around the VIOS Practice: intake (the six moves), the proposal with pricing from the practice's rate card, the engagement workspace setup (client folder, the five ClickUp lists and the Deliverables tasks, Drive, reviews, the month-0 baseline), and the harvest that closes an engagement with the retrospective, the case recommendation and the manuscript change-log entry. VIOS Practice Parts IV and V included. Requires vios-core.
